agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Management listing directly contains Asian Business School — Noida — Uttar Pradesh, establishing the government-directory match.

The official site confirms the Noida campus at Plot A2, Block A, Sector 125 Noida - 201303, Delhi NCR, but no reviewed official page explicitly names the Gautam Budh Nagar district; district remains null.

The official site exposes five active PGDM specialization pages and an additional diploma/certification/training list. The one-week Oxford residential trip was excluded as an event/experience, while the associated Executive Diploma in International Business was retained because the official page explicitly states that students earn it.

EDIC, AIMA BizLab, and Corporate Communication are listed by the official site as additional offerings, but their reviewed pages do not provide standalone programme credentials, durations, or eligibility; therefore the course catalogue is partial and the record requires manual review.

Normal TLS was attempted first. The managed proxy returned curl error 60 for the expected public hosts: self signed certificate in certificate chain. The --insecure fallback was used only for public GET requests to the confirmed NIRF, search, and abs.edu.in hosts.
career_path.db was queried read-only with sqlite3; career breadcrumbs were reconstructed from the database parent_id/name hierarchy and the database was not edited.
